title: Not heavy,  not soft and cuddly. Good for summer evenings.
text:
Not heavy, not soft and cuddly. Good for summer evenings.. This throw is just ok for decoration. It's a pretty common pattern. it's not cozy to cuddle with.
It felt softer before I washed this Dll throw, and I used a good dryer sheet.
After I washed the throw I could see little thread pulls when I took it out of the dryer.
This did warm my feet at night, but its not going to over heat your feet.

I would use this throw for a cool summer evening.
2 1/2 stars
